$comment: Touched-row manifest legacy-shares-v1 (ROUNDS-00B-L06, #14): what pocketbase/pb_migrations/1700008500_legacy_share_migration.js changes, with each change's disposition. Every share link made before the release that carries it stops working, its owner can get a new link for a migrated one, and no secret any of them was made with survives. Which rows a database holds depends on its data, so the dispositions are per collection. The owner approves the drops and the quarantine strip, so owner_approval stays pending until the owner reviews it, and the migration's lint entry waits on that review.

journal.rows: one per share link, live or quarantined, keyed by (manifest, link)
journal.id: the link's own id, so no two links share a row; a later manifest keeps a journal of its own
journal.checksum: sha256 over the canonical JSON of the rows sorted by id: id, manifest, predicate_version, link, origin, quarantine_entry, outcome, reason, views, first_view_day, last_view_day, incident; never their dates
journal.rerun: a link that already has a journal row keeps its outcome, reason, view counts, and date, so a second forward run writes the same journal

precedence: ownership, then the demo account, then the other reasons in the order listed

user_row_writes.why: every link is turned off with its outcome; a migrated one can get a new link, which sets replaced_by later, and nothing else on the row changes after this
a view keeps only its day; the per-link count and first and last day go to the journal

server_row_writes.when: an entry whose source_collection is resume_share_links
server_row_writes.why: a quarantined link is turned off like every other one, and a replay restores only what the entry still holds

server_row_writes.when: an entry whose source_collection is resume_share_views
server_row_writes.why: the first two go and viewed_at keeps only its day, as for live views
the journal: one row per link, every rule null

migrations.down: keeps the journal, the rules, legacy_status, replaced_by, and its triggers; removes legacy_reason, turned_off_at, and manifest_id; puts expires_at, is_password, password_hash, and token back empty, none required, with no index. It restores no secret and turns no link back on.
migrations.untouched: every other collection, and every other field of the two share collections
